metrics.profile_summary: Seasoned marketing professional with over 21 years of experience specializing in advertising, BTL, and brand management. Expert in leading integrated campaigns and managing large-scale client services across diverse sectors. Proven track record in team leadership and strategic budget execution.

education.degree: Master of Business Administration & Information Technology

education.institution: Gulistan Shah Abdul Latif boys Secondary School

experience.role: Head of Marketing & Client Service Manager
experience.description: Leads integrated marketing initiatives, manages annual and quarterly budgets, and utilizes web analytics to drive brand growth and customer satisfaction.
Executed BTL marketing campaigns, revamped brand image through strategic signage, and increased patient footfall by 15%.
Managed product launches and integrated media kits across FMCG, telecom, and retail sectors, focusing on BTL, OOH, and digital signage.
Revamped business structure and managed BTL activations and signage fabrication for various corporate clients.
Managed retail sales for premium furniture and oversaw outdoor media placements including hoardings and pylons.
Handled corporate sales, institutional client acquisition, and frontline customer support.

strengths: Extensive leadership and people management experience
Deep expertise in BTL/OOH and integrated campaigns
Strong local market knowledge in Karachi
Proven budget and agency management skills
weaknesses: Lack of explicit mention of GA4 and specific ad platform reporting tools
Heavy emphasis on traditional/BTL media over modern digital performance marketing
evaluation.summary: Highly experienced marketing leader with a massive track record in the Karachi market. While he possesses the leadership and strategic skills required, a technical interview is needed to verify proficiency in GA4 and digital reporting.
